_comment: Apex infra · Skew dashboard build-spec. HyperDX v2 stores dashboards in MongoDB with an internal shape, so this is a REPRODUCIBLE SPEC (source + query + viz per tile), not a raw import blob. Recreate in HyperDX: Dashboards -> New, add one tile per entry below against the 'Spark Events' source. Every tile's query matches sql/050 for the same job_id/window, so a tile and the raw SQL agree. See HYPERDX_SETUP.md.
name: Apex — Spark Skew

tiles.title: Skew per stage (retry-safe ratio; tail-bound verdict when the width is known)
tiles.description: The core skew signal — mirrors sql/050 query (A) verbatim: successful-task population when sampled, closed-form verdict (n_tasks-1)/(slots-1) from job_conf width; NULL verdict + min_slots_for_tail_bound when the width is unknown (CONTRACT.md rule 1). A tile cannot carry an operator width, so operator_slots stays NULL here.
tiles.sql: Per-stage skew from raw events (last 6h). For each (job_id, stage_id) take the latest WITH NULL AS operator_slots SELECT job_id, stage_id, max(stage_attempt) AS attempt, argMax(if(successful_task_sample_count > 0, 'successful', 'all_attempts'), ts) AS population, argMax(if(successful_task_sample_count > 0, successful_task_sample_count, task_count), ts) AS n_tasks, argMax(if(successful_task_sample_count > 0, successful_task_duration_p50_ms, task_duration_p50_ms), ts) AS p50_ms, argMax(if(successful_task_sample_count > 0, successful_task_duration_p99_ms, task_duration_p99_ms), ts) AS p99_ms, round(p99_ms / nullIf(p50_ms, 0), 2) AS skew_ratio, sum(spill_disk_bytes) AS spill_disk_bytes, coalesce(nullIf(any(conf_slots), 0), operator_slots) AS slots, n_tasks <= slots AS single_wave, if(slots > 1 AND n_tasks > slots, round((n_tasks - 1) / (slots - 1), 2), NULL) AS tail_bound_threshold, if(tail_bound_threshold IS NULL, NULL, skew_ratio > tail_bound_threshold) AS tail_bound, if(skew_ratio > 0 AND n_tasks >= 2, round(1 + (n_tasks - 1) / skew_ratio, 2), NULL) AS min_slots_for_tail_bound FROM apex.spark_events LEFT JOIN ( SELECT job_id, toUInt32OrZero(conf['spark.executor.instances']) * toUInt32OrZero(conf['spark.executor.cores']) AS conf_slots FROM apex.job_conf ) AS c USING (job_id) WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR GROUP BY job_id, stage_id HAVING p50_ms > 0 ORDER BY tail_bound DESC NULLS LAST, skew_ratio DESC

tiles.title: Max skew ratio over time (per job)
tiles.description: Time series; group by job_id. Uses the rollup for auto-acceleration (register spark_jobs_1m, 1-min granularity).
tiles.sql_equivalent: SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS t, job_id, max(if(successful_task_sample_count > 0, successful_task_duration_p99_ms, task_duration_p99_ms) / nullIf(if(successful_task_sample_count > 0, successful_task_duration_p50_ms, task_duration_p50_ms), 0)) AS max_skew FROM apex.spark_events GROUP BY t, job_id

tiles.title: Disk spill by job (bytes)
tiles.description: Skew's downstream symptom. sum__spill_disk_bytes accelerates off spark_jobs_1m.

tiles.title: Rollup skew (p99/p50 of per-stage p99, successful sample preferred)
tiles.description: Mirrors sql/050 query (B) verbatim — recomputes percentiles from the quantile STATE in spark_jobs_1m (quantilesIf__successful_* when the bucket carries a successful sample). Ranks only; the per-stage verdict is tile 1.
tiles.sql: From the rollup sketch — p50/p99 of the per-stage p99 distribution per bucket, from the SELECT bucket, job_id, sum(sum__successful_task_sample_count) AS successful_samples, if(successful_samples > 0, 'successful', 'all_attempts') AS population, if(successful_samples > 0, quantilesIfMerge(0.5, 0.99)(quantilesIf__successful_task_duration_p99_ms), quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.99)(quantiles__task_duration_p99_ms)) AS q, round(q[2] / nullIf(q[1], 0), 2) AS p99_over_p50 FROM apex.spark_jobs_1m WHERE bucket >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY bucket, job_id HAVING q[1] > 0 ORDER BY p99_over_p50 DESC
